item.description:
Browser web features (build 286)

  • Picture in picture for videos in the browser. Videos can also go full screen.
  • Real alert, confirm and prompt dialogs, with a Don't allow more dialogs box so a page cannot keep asking.
  • Spell check while you type in web pages.
  • Pinch to zoom, and Cmd+ / Cmd- / Cmd-0 to zoom the page. Pages that use these keys still get them first. Limitation: zoom is not remembered per site.
  • Inspect Element in the right-click menu.
  • Websites can ask for your location; macOS asks you first.
  • The agent working bar and the GitHub Actions spinner now animate on Core Animation and pause when the window is hidden, which uses much less CPU.
  • Terminals follow the refresh rate of the display their window is on.
  • GitHub Actions: the Add to Devkitty button sits in GitHub's own button row and is hidden when the workflow is already pinned.
  • GitHub Actions: a run shows the in-progress icon while any of its jobs runs, not waiting.
